newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto Co Q4 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto Co Q4 loss vs profit.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 net loss includes after-tax non-recurring charge of $500 million or $0.84/share to establish reserves for spinoff of chemical operations and other restructuring actions.
Q4 1996 income excluding charge $90.0 million or $0.15 a share.

Q4 1995 net income included an after-tax, nonrecurring charge of $9.0 million or $0.02 a share. Included in that after-tax charge are a $156.0 million pretax restructuring expense, $189.0 million pretax gain on sale of styrenics business and $13.0 million in other pretax expenses.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: 1996 results include $500 million or $0.84 a share after-tax charge to establish reserves for the spinoff of chemical operations and other restructuring actions. Excluding this charge, 1996 net income would have been $885 million or $1.48 a share, both records.
1995 results included net after tax gain of $11 million or $0.02 a share.
